policies.rule: CLI may only project; writes only via service SessionManager
CLI does not hold lock file; only service writes
exactly one matcher implementation across service and CLI
single owner; other modules may import types only
no source file > 500 lines; bootstrap only owns the loader, every primitive in its own file
no stubs; every action_id must point to a real module under services/autoscript/actions/
action_id must exist in registry; missing action_id fails schema validation, never silently ok
single writer; ws daemon only fans out
every envelope has explicit version; ad-hoc json is forbidden
every error carries an Error01Code; user-facing message is projected, never constructed inline
